categories.main_business_segments: HuangShan Googe Co., Ltd. specializes in the research, development, production, and sales of power semiconductor module cooling substrates, primarily serving the automotive parts manufacturing industry with a focus on new energy vehicles. Its main products include copper pin-type and copper flat-bottom cooling substrates used in power semiconductor modules for electric motor controllers in new energy vehicles, as well as applications in new energy power generation and energy storage.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs innovative cold precision forging technology to produce copper pin-type cooling substrates, which significantly enhance heat dissipation and enable miniaturization of power modules. It has developed proprietary mold design and manufacturing capabilities to support high durability and precision in mass production. The production process is customer order-driven, with strict quality control and traceability systems in place.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are leading domestic and international power semiconductor manufacturers such as Infineon, Bosch, ON Semiconductor, STMicroelectronics, CRRC Times, and others. The company indirectly supports new energy vehicle manufacturers through these semiconductor module manufacturers and is expanding direct supply to vehicle manufacturers' semiconductor subsidiaries. The primary market is the new energy vehicle sector, with growing applications in renewable energy and energy storage.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with headquarters and production facilities in Huangshan City, Anhui Province. Domestic sales account for over 80% of revenue, while international sales, including to Japan and other countries, represent about 19%. The company is actively expanding its presence in overseas markets, particularly Japan.
categories.supply_chain_position: HuangShan Googe operates primarily in the midstream segment of the power semiconductor supply chain, focusing on manufacturing critical cooling substrates for power semiconductor modules used in new energy vehicles. It serves as a key component supplier to semiconductor module manufacturers and vehicle manufacturers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous R&D investment to enhance product technology, quality, and manufacturing efficiency. It focuses on developing high-value-added products, expanding product categories, and exploring new application fields. Key R&D initiatives include automation and intelligent manufacturing upgrades, development of new substrate types, and AI-based quality inspection systems. The company also prioritizes synchronous development with customers to shorten product development cycles.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of customized power semiconductor module cooling substrates to semiconductor manufacturers and vehicle manufacturers. The company operates on a make-to-order basis, with pricing linked to raw material costs and customer contracts. It also derives minor revenue from related services such as plating processing through its subsidiary.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading position in the niche market of automotive-grade power semiconductor module cooling substrates in China. It competes with other domestic and international suppliers but benefits from high entry barriers due to stringent quality and certification requirements in the automotive semiconductor industry. Its long-term partnerships with top-tier semiconductor firms and advanced proprietary technologies provide a competitive edge.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 724.6 million, a slight decline of 4.53% from the previous year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 111.9 million, down 28.84%. Total assets nearly doubled to RMB 1.23 billion, driven by capital raised from a successful IPO on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in early 2025. The company is in a growth phase, expanding production capacity and R&D capabilities.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: HuangShan Googe differentiates itself through its advanced cold precision forging technology, enabling superior heat dissipation and miniaturization of power semiconductor modules critical for new energy vehicles. Its products meet stringent automotive-grade quality standards, ensuring reliability and performance under harsh conditions. The company's strong R&D capabilities, synchronous development with customers, and stable supply chain relationships provide high-quality, customized solutions that enhance customer satisfaction and create high switching costs.
